name: report-forge
description: Multi-agent report generation system. Orchestrates investigator, analyst, and synthesizer agents to research topics and produce structured markdown reports through forge-lib.

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generate a new report through multi-agent investigation

commands.name: update
commands.description: Update an existing report with new findings

agents.name: forge-investigator
agents.description: Primary research agent. Gathers data, examines codebases, collects metrics, and assembles raw findings without interpretation.

agents.name: forge-analyst
agents.description: Analysis agent. Interprets findings from the Investigator, identifies patterns and anomalies, assesses risks and opportunities.

agents.name: forge-synthesizer
agents.description: Assembly agent. Receives findings and analysis, assembles the final narrative report following appropriate structure.

skills.name: report-methodology
skills.description: Defines report types, audience guidance, tone standards, and agent recruitment logic.
